_readme: Built by scripts/build-forecast.py from EIA weekly data. Do not edit by hand. Base rates are computed from these records.

sources.petroleum: EIA Weekly Petroleum Status Report history (eia.gov/dnav/pet hist_xls): crude=WCESTUS1, gasoline=WGTSTUS1, distillate=WDISTUS1, spr=WCSSTUS1, util=WPULEUS3, runs=WCRRIUS2, prod=WCRFPUS2, imports=WCRIMUS2, exports=WCREXUS2. Stock changes are week-on-week differences of the levels. WTI = NYMEX front-month daily settle via Yahoo Finance CL=F; S&P 500 via Yahoo ^GSPC. Release dates computed from EIA's schedule (Wednesday, moved for federal holidays). API/consensus: scripts/forecast-api-consensus.json, cited per week.
sources.gas: EIA Weekly Natural Gas Storage Report history (eia.gov/dnav/ng hist_xls): Lower 48 working gas NW2_EPG0_SWO_R48_BCF. 5-year average = mean change for the same week over the prior five years, from the same series. Henry Hub = NYMEX front-month daily settle via Yahoo Finance NG=F. Release dates computed (Thursday, moved for federal holidays).
